title: Governed action request
description: A request to execute an action through masugated. Identity and admission time are derived by the server. Adapter callers may additionally supply a canonical invocation assertion that the server verifies against the authenticated request and durably binds to replay.

adapter_invocation.description: Canonical masugate.host-adapter.v1 invocation JSON. masugated verifies its principal, action, and arguments against the authenticated request and binds its SHA-256 digest to idempotent replay.
